items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: Zeke Mullins — Zeke was Hamp’s piano player for what 20-some years?... Now that Zeke isn’t with us anymore, Danny Mixon plays piano with us now... Doc would make sure there were gigs... he created the band and he kept it going... he called on me to kind of help out with some bookings

ctx.x: Because Fred was, his health was starting to be more challenged, you know, and that was — and Joey Morant was there and Art Baron on trombone. Now Art had played with, in the Ellington band when Duke was still leading it, and he’s got a lot of experience and stories and a great musician. Jackie [Williams], and Jackie on drums. The stories these cats had, and you learn man, it’s all about learning. Zeke Mullins — Zeke was Hamp’s piano player for what 20-some years? You know and Zeke, old Zeke man, they were really…
Yeah, she had that church Gospel combination with pig foot and a bottle of beer or something like that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
